subject: Deployment residency & preferred deployment mode — NordBank follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hanna Lind <hanna.lind@nordbank.ee>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Deployment residency & preferred deployment mode — NordBank follow-up

Hi Hanna —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment and clear next steps: 

- Requirements we captured:
  - Strict EU data residency: customer data, logs, and artifacts must remain in the EU and not be replicated outside the EU for processing or backups.
  - Production throughput target: ~2k requests/minute with P50 latency targets below 250ms for inference.
  - High availability requirement across two AZs (EU region) and a disaster recovery plan for APAC expansion in 2027.
  - Standard security/compliance: SOC 2, encryption at rest/in transit, audit logs, and customer-managed KMS preference.

- Deployment modes discussed:
  - Hosted API (regional endpoints): fastest to go-live, but for strict EU residency we need to validate full control over logging/replication.
  - Dedicated (reserved GPU pools in EU): provides predictable throughput and can be constrained to EU-only infrastructure — recommended for your latency/SLA needs.
  - Private VPC / on-prem: for the tightest control (air-gapped or customer-managed network); longer lead time and heavier ops but meets strict residency and KMS requirements.

My read: based on today’s conversation, Dedicated in an EU region is likely the best balance between speed-to-prod and residency guarantees; Private VPC would be the path if procurement or the security team requires complete isolation.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll share our SOC 2 and a short Dedicated overview (attached).
2) Can you confirm which deployment mode you want us to price/qualify (Dedicated vs Private VPC)?
3) Please confirm procurement contact and target timeline (PO vs contract, target start date).
4) If helpful, I can schedule a technical deep-dive with our infra lead to validate cross-region failover and KMS details.

Attachments: SOC2_Report_2025.pdf, Redwood-Dedicated-Overview.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to your confirmation so we can prepare options and a timeline.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193
https://redwood.ai
From: Hanna Lind <hanna.lind@nordbank.ee>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Petri Suomi <petri.suomi@nordbank.fi>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:40:12 +0200
Subject: Re: Deployment residency & preferred deployment mode — NordBank follow-up

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the detailed recap, that’s exactly right. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Residency: This is non-negotiable for the initial rollout — all customer data, logs, and metadata must remain in the EU. We also need confirmation that backups and any DR replicas will be EU-only.
- Preferred mode: We are leaning toward Dedicated capacity in the EU to start (predictable performance + easier procurement), but the security team wants to evaluate Private VPC if Dedicated cannot guarantee EU-only backups and key management.
- APAC: We expect to expand in H2 2027 — we’ll revisit architecture for cross-region replication then. For now, EU-only.
- Procurement: Petri (cc’d) is our procurement lead. Our default is a contract + PO; timeline target would be contract signed and pilot started by end of Q3 (target start ~2026-09-20).

Questions for you: 
1) Can Redwood guarantee EU-only storage and backups for Dedicated (no cross-region failover that moves data outside EU)?
2) Rough lead time & resource needs for Dedicated onboarding vs Private VPC (ballpark days/weeks).
3) Any limitations on using customer-managed KMS for Dedicated?

If you can answer these and provide a proposed SOW / costing for a 6-month pilot, we can pull procurement in.

Best,
Hanna Lind
Head of Platform Engineering | NordBank AS
Hanna.Lind@nordbank.ee
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hanna Lind <hanna.lind@nordbank.ee>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 13:00:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Deployment residency & preferred deployment mode — NordBank follow-up

Hi Hanna —

Really helpful questions — answer summary below and I’ve included recommended next steps.

1) EU-only guarantees for Dedicated: 
   - Yes — we can provision Dedicated capacity that is physically hosted in an EU region (we operate in eu-west for this offering). Backups and snapshots for Dedicated customers can be configured to remain in the EU; we will include this in the SOW and operational runbook. For the strictest control we recommend Private VPC but Dedicated with EU-only controls is a supported configuration.

2) Lead times (ballpark):
   - Dedicated (EU reserved capacity): ~4–6 weeks for capacity provisioning, initial onboarding, and performance tuning (assumes SOW and PO complete).
   - Private VPC / on-prem: ~8–12 weeks depending on network approvals, access to customer environment, and any on-prem hardware procurement.

3) Customer-managed KMS: 
   - Supported for Private VPC. For Dedicated we support customer-managed keys via a KMS integration (bring-your-own KMS) in many cases — there are a few additional validation steps in the security review. We’ll include KMS options in the security appendix.

Recommended next steps:
- I’ll put together a short SOW and a 6-month pilot pricing for Dedicated (HSP-7832). Rishi (cc) can take lead on pricing.
- Vivek (cc) — can you +1 availability for a technical deep-dive this week or next? We want infra/ops questions from NordBank addressed (backups, KMS, cross-region failover constraints).
- Petri / Hanna — if you can confirm procurement cadence (contract + PO), we’ll attach a SOW and a DocuSign link for signature.

I’ve attached our SOC2 and the Dedicated overview again and will follow with a draft SOW by EOD tomorrow.

DocuSign link (placeholder): https://docusign.com/embedded/ABC-DocuSign-Link

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: NordBank (HSP-7832) — qualification + next internal steps

Folks — quick internal note (cc’d in external thread) after Hanna’s reply: 

Summary: NordBank requires strict EU-only residency. They are leaning to Dedicated in EU but security may push for Private VPC if we cannot include EU-only backups and customer-managed KMS in the SOW. Procurement target: contract + PO, pilot start by ~2026-09-20.

Proposed internal plan: 
- Recommend we propose a Dedicated EU reserved-capacity pilot (6 months) with an explicit EU-only data residency clause and KMS integration options. Include runbook for backups and DR constrained to EU.
- Rishi: can you prepare two price options by EOD Monday — (A) 6-month pilot (reserved capacity) with standard support, (B) Dedicated + optional Private VPC migration path (estimate effort + cost to transition). Mark the deal_id HSP-7832 on the quote.
- Vivek: please own the security follow-up; I’ll send the security questionnaire and request a short workshop with their SecOps. We need to confirm KMS flow for Dedicated and the backup/DR constraints.
- I’ll draft the SOW and attach Redwood-Dedicated-SOW.pdf to the external thread once pricing is aligned.

Attachments for internal reference: Redwood-Dedicated-SOW.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa
